Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.scenemanager.utils.startmenu.model.orbit

Class OrbitLayout

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.scenemanager.utils.startmenu.model.orbit.OrbitLayout
All Implemented Interfaces:
LayoutManager3D
public class OrbitLayout extends Object implements LayoutManager3D
This Layout Manager arranges components in an orbit around the origin of the container. Currently, components are layed out only in a circular orbit, but a future revision should support elliptic orbits as well. The inclineAngle and offsetAngle parameters allows the control of rotation in two of the three planes (respectively, the xy-plane and the xz-plane).

    • layoutContainer

      public void layoutContainer()
      Layout a container in an orbit based on the specified geometry. Each component is positioned evenly [ 2nπ/N units ] around a circle of given radius centered at (0,0,0). Each component is positioned at an altitude angle determined by the position of the component and the inclineAngle, resulting in 'tilt' and 'offset-rotation' to the orbit. This method also sets the correct rotation axis for the components to spin about the center. This calculates the second point defining the line through (0,0,0) that is perpedicular to the plane of orbit.
      Specified by:
      layoutContainer in interface LayoutManager3D
